mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(created_at >= #{startToday} AND created_at < #{endTomorrow}), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(created_at >= #{start7}), 0) AS last7, COALESCE(SUM(created_at >= #{start30}), 0) AS last30 FROM users

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(status = 0), 0) AS queued, COALESCE(SUM(status = 1), 0) AS processing, COALESCE(SUM(status = 2), 0) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(status = 3), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(created_at >= #{start7}), 0) AS last7, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN consume_credits ELSE 0 END), 0) AS creditsDone FROM tryon_tasks

SELECT task_type AS taskType, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(created_at >= #{start7}), 0) AS last7, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN consume_credits ELSE 0 END), 0) AS creditsSuccess FROM gemini_image_tasks WHERE task_type IN ('EDIT', 'CLOTHING_PRODUCT_SUITE', 'CLOTHING_PACKSHOT') GROUP BY task_type
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(created_at >= #{start7}), 0) AS last7 FROM user_upload_records
SELECT COUNT(*) AS paidCount, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS paidSum, COALESCE(SUM(paid_at >= #{start7}), 0) AS paid7 FROM orders WHERE status = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_recharged), 0) AS credits, COALESCE(SUM(total_recharged_amount), 0) AS amount FROM user_wallets
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{start14} AND created_at < #{endTomorrow} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM tryon_tasks WHERE created_at >= #{start14} AND created_at < #{endTomorrow} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, task_type AS taskType, COUNT(*) AS c FROM gemini_image_tasks WHERE created_at >= #{start14} AND created_at < #{endTomorrow} AND task_type IN ('EDIT', 'CLOTHING_PRODUCT_SUITE', 'CLOTHING_PACKSHOT') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d'), task_type
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM user_upload_records WHERE created_at >= #{start14} AND created_at < #{endTomorrow} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amt FROM orders WHERE status = 1 AND paid_at >= #{start14} AND paid_at < #{endTomorrow} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d')
